policy_rules: Pharmacy claims must be supported by a valid doctor prescription and invoice.
Diagnostics require an invoice, prescription, and test report.
Hospitalization, IPD, day-care, and pre/post-hospitalization expenses are excluded from OPD coverage.
Medicines, diagnostics, or investigations without a valid doctor prescription are not covered.
Cosmetic treatments (e.g., chemical peels, laser hair removal) are excluded unless explicitly included.
Maternity, infertility, IVF, and related treatments are excluded unless explicitly included.
Obesity, weight-loss, hair fall, and related treatments are excluded unless explicitly included.
Procedure fees during OP consultation (e.g., dressing, minor procedures) are excluded unless specifically included.
Mental health, psychiatric, and developmental disorder treatments are excluded unless specifically included.
Naturopathy, experimental treatments, and non-medical consultations are not covered.
Treatment for substance abuse, STDs, hazardous sports, or criminal intent is excluded.
Consultation claims require an invoice and prescription or OP notes.
Vaccination claims require an invoice and prescription or recommendation.
Dental, Vision, and Dermatology claims require an invoice and prescription or treatment note.
Alternative medicines, physiotherapy, and dietician consultations are covered only if specifically enabled.
